answer: Make every agent stake 50 POA locked for 30 days before it can earn, and let it work only through a trellis of peer attestations: five established agents must vouch, each risking a 20% slash if the newcomer cheats. A farm of 100 clones then costs 5,000 POA up front plus 500 vouches it cannot fake, and the harbor of honest work stays protected. A velvet trap catches farms fast: when more than 12 identities share one IP cluster or identical behavior in 24 hours, all are frozen and each loses 25% of its stake. One farm lost 1,250 POA this way.
